rationale: The original entry premise of a breakdown below the $530-$532 consolidation zone and containment beneath the 5-minute 9-EMA ($533.25) has failed. Price has printed three consecutive 1-minute higher highs and higher closes on elevated volume, reclaiming both the consolidation range and the 5-minute 9-EMA at $533.97. Exiting now cuts the loss early rather than waiting for the hard stop at $535.50 after the technical structure has already shifted against the short.
